source.statement: SELECT DISTINCT CATEGORY AS CATEGORY_KEY FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.MOCK_DATA.TH_LINES

Categories.description: Conformed line-category dimension (5 rows): joins Lines and Fleet so one category filter reaches both.

source.statement: SELECT LPAD(SEQ4()::STRING, 2, '0') || ':00' AS HOUR_KEY, CASE WHEN SEQ4() < 6 THEN '1. Night (0–6)' WHEN SEQ4() < 10 THEN '2. AM peak (6–10)' WHEN SEQ4() < 14 THEN '3. Midday (10–14)' WHEN SEQ4() < 18 THEN '4. PM peak (14–18)' WHEN SEQ4() < 21 THEN '5. Evening (18–21)' ELSE '6. Late (21–24)' END AS HOUR_BAND FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 24))

Hours.description: Conformed hour-of-day dimension (24 rows, 00:00–23:00): joins Service and Fleet so time-of-day filters reach both.

Clock Hour.description: Hour of the day, reference weekday.

Connectivity.description: Number of lines calling at the stop.

Fleet Category.description: Line category of the buses in service.

Frequency Tier.description: Weekday 07–10 headway in the main direction: ≤10, 11–20, 21–40, >40 min, or no AM service.

Hour.description: Hour of day the trip departs its first stop (00:00 … 23:00).

Line Category.description: Urban core (<50), Suburban (50–79), Regional (80+), Night (…N), Airport (01X/01N). Approximate grouping from the line number.

Line Label.description: Line number and English route name.

Line Name.description: Route name in Greek as published by OSETH.

Route Stop.description: A stop on the selected line.

Sector.description: Compass sector from Aristotelous Square; Centre within 2 km.

Service Date.description: Calendar date of scheduled service, 14 Jul – 3 Aug 2026.

Service Day.description: MM-DD and weekday, sorts in date order.

Service Level.description: Weekday 07–10 departures per hour at the stop, all lines.

Service Week.description: Week 1–3 of the timetable period, Tuesday to Monday.

Speed Band.description: Scheduled commercial speed of a typical weekday trip.

Ten-Minute Slot.description: Clock time rounded down to 10 minutes, reference weekday.

Time Band.description: Night 0–6, AM peak 6–10, Midday 10–14, PM peak 14–18, Evening 18–21, Late 21–24.

Weekday.description: 1 Mon … 7 Sun, sorts in week order.

AM Buses per Hour.description: Mean weekday 07–10 buses per hour at a stop.

Active Lines.description: Lines with at least one scheduled trip in scope.

Avg Longest Gap.description: Mean longest daytime gap across stops, minutes.

Buses at 8am.description: Buses in service at 08:00 on the reference weekday.

Buses in Service.description: Average buses on the road per minute in scope: SUM(buses active) ÷ COUNT DISTINCT(minute). Additive across categories.

Distance from Centre.description: Mean straight-line km from Aristotelous Square.

Frequent Stops.description: Stops with ≥6 buses an hour in the weekday AM peak.

Line Speed.description: Mean scheduled speed of a typical weekday trip, km/h.

Line Stops Served.description: Stops served by the line (both directions).

Line Weekday Trips.description: Trips on the reference weekday (Tue 21 Jul 2026).

Lines per Stop.description: Mean number of lines calling at a stop.

Longest Gap.description: Longest weekday 07–20 wait between buses at the stop, minutes.

Network Route Km.description: Sum of typical route lengths (one direction).

Peak Buses per Hour.description: Stop weekday 07–10 buses per hour (max across rows).

Peak Minute Buses.description: Largest per-row buses active (per minute and category).

Route Stop Calls.description: Weekday calls of the line at the stop.

Route Stop Lat.description: Latitude of a stop on the line.

Route Stop Lon.description: Longitude of a stop on the line.

Service Span.description: Hours from first to last departure, weekday.

Share of Departures.description: Weekday departures ÷ departures of the whole answer.

Share of Trips.description: Trips ÷ trips of the whole answer (share of total).

Share of Vehicle Km.description: Vehicle-km ÷ vehicle-km of the whole answer.

Stop Calls.description: Scheduled bus calls at stops: the network’s boarding opportunities.

Stop Calls per Day.description: Average scheduled stop calls per service day.

Stop Sunday Retention.description: Sunday departures ÷ weekday departures at stops.

Stops Without Sunday Bus.description: Stops with weekday service but no bus on the reference Sunday.

Sunday Retention.description: Sunday trips per day ÷ weekday trips per day: how much of the weekday network survives on Sunday.

Trips.description: Scheduled bus trips (departures from the first stop).

Trips Departing.description: Trips leaving their first stop, reference weekday.

Trips per Day.description: Average scheduled trips per service day (ratio of aggregates).

Underserved Stops.description: Served stops with fewer than 3 buses an hour in the weekday AM peak.

Vehicle Hours.description: Scheduled in-service bus hours (first to last stop).

Vehicle Hours per Day.description: Average scheduled vehicle-hours per service day.

Vehicle Km.description: Scheduled in-service bus kilometres (shape length × trips).

Vehicle Km per Day.description: Average scheduled vehicle-km per service day.

Weekday Departures.description: Bus departures from the stop on the reference weekday, all lines.
